metadata.author: Original NorCal Trail Game
metadata.description: A psychedelic journey from Boston to San Francisco in a VW bus during the 1960s counterculture movement

professions.description: You've got connections and cash, but the cops are watching you, man.
You left school to find yourself. More resourceful but haunted by doubt.
You see beauty everywhere but barely have two pennies to rub together.

landmarkData.title: 🌉 SAN FRANCISCO! 🌉
landmarkData.description: Far out! You made it to the promised land! Haight-Ashbury awaits with open arms. The summer of love is alive and well! ✌️🌻

early.text: You see a hitchhiker on the roadside. They flag you down. Do you pick them up?

choices.message: 'Ass, Grass, or Gas - Nobody Rides for Free!' They hand you $25. Good deal, but kinda greedy, man.
'Ass, Grass, or Gas!' They contribute to the herb collection! The vibes are EXCELLENT! ✌️
'Ass, Grass, or Gas!' They pour 15 units of gas from their can into your tank. Far out!
You give them a free ride. Spread the love, man! They share cool stories and good vibes.
You drive past. They flip you off. Bad karma, dude.

early.text: 💥 BREAKDOWN! Your VW bus sputters and dies on the side of the road! What do you do?

choices.message: You pop the hood and get to work...
You find a local mechanic. It's expensive and takes all day, but it's fixed.
You use your spare parts and fix it quickly! Smart thinking!
choices.failMessage: You don't have any spare parts!

early.text: 🎪 You stumble upon a small music festival in a field! Live bands, dancing, the whole scene! Sunshine's eyes light up: 'Can we STAY?!'

choices.message: You break out the guitar and JAM for hours! People share food! This is EVERYTHING! ✨🎸
You dance until your feet hurt! Worth every second! This is LIVING! 🌈
You relax with some herbs, listen to the music, and soak it all in. Perfect vibes! ☮️
Everyone's bummed. 'We NEVER get to have fun!' Oof. Morale hit.

early.text: 🚨 The fuzz pulls you over. 'Your taillight's out, hippie.'

choices.message: You hand over the cash. The cop smirks and drives off.
He's not interested in your philosophy. He writes you TWO tickets out of spite.
choices.failMessage: He's not interested in your philosophy. He writes you TWO tickets out of spite.

choices.message: You peel out. Your VW bus goes 0-60 in... never. He doesn't even bother chasing you. But now you're paranoid for 200 miles.
choices.failMessage: He catches you immediately. Your bus tops out at 40mph. Now you're getting arrested. This takes DAYS to sort out.

early.text: 🍽️ Classic roadside diner! Chrome and neon! The waitress calls you 'hon.' Moonbeam is CHARMED.

choices.message: Eggs, bacon, pancakes, toast! Moonbeam: 'This is HEAVEN!' Best $15 you've spent! 🥞
The pie is AMAZING. The coffee could strip paint. Balanced experience! ☕🥧
You play guitar! Tips AND free food! The waitress loves you! 'Y'all come back now!' 🎸
Everyone's disappointed. The smell of bacon haunts you for miles.

early.text: 🌅 Sunset over the plains. Sky goes orange, then pink, then purple. River whispers: 'Far out...' Nobody moves for 20 minutes.

choices.message: You set up the camera on the roof. Timer goes off. PERFECT sunset photo with everyone! This is going on the wall! 📷✨
You share the herbs in total silence. The colors! The VIBES! This is why you're out here! 🌄💫
No photos. No words. Just experiencing it. When it's over, everyone exhales. Perfect moment. ☮️
Everyone gives you the LOOK. 'SERIOUSLY?!' You stop. Too late, sun's already set. Blew it.

early.text: 💥 FLAT TIRE. Middle of nowhere. No shade. Stardust kicks the tire: 'Of COURSE.'

choices.message: Hot, sweaty, miserable work. But you get it done! Everyone's grumpy but impressed. 💪
You take 20 minutes to chill with the herbs first. Makes the job WAY less annoying! Work smarter, not harder! 😎
A trucker stops and helps! You slip him $20. Fixed faster but costs cash.
You've got a spare! Quick swap! Back on the road! Smart planning! 🛞

early.text: 🍲 Sweet old lady: 'You kids look hungry! I made too much casserole!' It smells AMAZING.

choices.message: Best meal you've had in WEEKS! She packs you leftovers! 'You remind me of my grandkids!' 😭💕

choices.text: 🎸 'Only if we can play you a song!'
choices.message: You eat AND perform! She claps along! 'You kids are alright!' She gives you $20! Best gig ever! 🎵
Everyone glares at you. Moonbeam: 'WHY DID YOU SAY NO?!' You drove past FREE FOOD. Idiot.

early.text: 📀 SCORE! Someone threw out a Beatles album! 'Abbey Road'! Vinyl looks perfect!

choices.message: You blast it for HOURS! Singing every word! Dancing in the bus! 'Come Together' never sounded so good! 🎸

choices.text: 💰 'Sell it! This could be worth money!'
choices.message: You sell it for $25. Everyone's mad. Stardust: 'We sold HAPPINESS for gas money.' Oof.

choices.text: 🎁 'Give it to that cool record store guy!'
choices.message: Record store dude is STOKED! 'You're beautiful people!' Gives you free snacks! Karma works! ✌️

early.text: ⭐ Perfect night for stargazing! Sky is INSANE! Milky Way looks like someone spilled glitter!

choices.message: You see THREE shooting stars! Deep talks about life! This is why you're ALIVE! Magic! ✨🌠
'Blackbird' never sounded better. You're in HEAVEN. This moment is EVERYTHING. 🎵⭐
You sleep fine. But you missed something INCREDIBLE. River: 'That was a once-in-a-lifetime sky, man.'

early.text: The bus overheats! Gotta let it cool down. Drag city.
🎸 Traveling band pulled over! They've got bongos, harmonicas, a BANJO! 'Wanna jam?!'

choices.message: EPIC JAM SESSION! 3 hours of pure musical JOY! They teach you new songs! This is LIVING! 🎶✨
You form a SUPERGROUP! Play a gig in the next town! Make $40! Crowd goes WILD! LEGENDARY! 🎸💥
Still awesome! You soak it in. But you could've BEEN part of it. Stardust: 'Next time, man!'

early.text: ☮️ Street artist: 'Your bus needs DECORATION! I got spraypaint!' He's already shaking the can!

choices.message: MASSIVE peace signs! Flowers! RAINBOWS! Your bus is now a WORK OF ART! People CHEER as you drive by! ☮️🌈
Simple but beautiful! Perfect-sized peace sign on the side! You look like REAL hippies now! Far out! ☮️
He looks hurt. Everyone's disappointed. River: 'Are we REALLY hippies if we're scared of paint?'

early.text: 📻 Radio plays 'Dock of the Bay'! River: 'THIS IS MY JAM!' Everyone knows the words!

choices.message: You're SCREAMING the lyrics! Strangers in other cars join in! Pure JOY! This is WHY you live! 🎵💕

choices.text: 🎸 'Stop the bus! Let's play it LIVE!'
choices.message: Roadside concert! You NAIL it! Passing cars honk! Someone throws you $5! BEAUTIFUL moment! 🎸✨
Nice song. But you could've made it a MEMORY. Moonbeam: 'Sometimes I worry about you, man.'

early.text: 🏊 SECRET SWIMMING HOLE! Crystal clear! Rope swing! Locals say it's the BEST spot for miles!

choices.message: BEST. DAY. EVER! Rope swing! Diving! Splashing! You're kids again! This is FREEDOM! 🌊✨
LIBERATED! No inhibitions! Pure hippie vibes! Everyone feels ALIVE and FREE! Far OUT! 🌺☮️
Everyone's FURIOUS. Stardust: 'We passed PARADISE for WHAT?!' You messed up big time.

early.text: 🎡 CARNIVAL! Ferris wheel! Cotton candy! Game booths! Calliope music! It's CALLING you!

choices.message: MAGICAL day! Win stuffed animals! Ride EVERYTHING! Eat way too much! Worth EVERY penny! 🎡🍭
You win a goldfish! (It dies in 2 days but whatever!) Fun times! Good memories! 🐠
Everyone's depressed for 50 miles. Moonbeam cries a little. River: 'Money isn't EVERYTHING, man.'

early.text: 🚗 Station wagon full of squares pulls up. Dad yells: 'Get a JOB, hippies!' His kids are staring.

choices.message: You smile and wave! One kid waves back! Dad looks confused! You WIN with kindness! ☮️
Screaming match! His kids look scared! You feel BAD now! That wasn't groovy at all! 😔
Hendrix at FULL BLAST! They speed away! River: 'Music always wins!' 🎵

early.text: ⛽ Gas station says 'CHEAP GAS!' But the owner looks sketchy. Really sketchy.

choices.text: 💰 'Fill it up! Can't pass this up!'
choices.message: SCORE! You save $10! The gas smells weird but whatever! Bargain! 🎉
choices.failMessage: The gas was WATERED DOWN! Bus sputters and dies! Takes a DAY to fix! YOU GOT SCAMMED! 😡

choices.message: Smart move! Gas seems OK! You don't trust him enough to fill up though.
You drive away. Two miles later you see a cop car at that station! DODGED A BULLET! ✨

early.text: 🎸 Radio plays a LEGENDARY Hendrix solo! River: 'Turn it UP! This is CHURCH!'

choices.message: Your EARS are RINGING! You don't CARE! THIS IS LIVING! JIMI FOREVER! 🎸⚡
EPIC air guitar session! Cars honk as they pass! You're ALL Hendrix right now! LEGENDARY! 🎸✨
Everyone STARES at you in horror. River: 'Did you just... diss HENDRIX?!' Vibes RUINED.

early.text: 🌭 Gas station hot dog been spinning for DAYS. Moonbeam: 'I'm starving!' She's reaching for it...

choices.message: You buy her a sandwich instead. She's grateful! Smart move! That hot dog looked LETHAL! 🥪
She eats it. 2 hours later: DISASTER. Bus smells AWFUL. She's SICK. You're stopped for a DAY. 🤢

choices.text: 😈 'I'll eat it! I got an iron stomach!'
choices.message: HUGE MISTAKE. You're VIOLENTLY ILL for a day and a half. Everyone's mad. Stardust: 'IDIOT.' 💀

early.text: 🦅 HUGE hawk lands on your hood! Majestic! It stares RIGHT AT YOU. Doesn't move.

choices.message: 10 minutes of pure AWE! It flies away slowly! You all feel BLESSED! That was a SIGN! 🦅✨
It eats! Then flies off! River: 'We just fed a SPIRIT ANIMAL!' Beautiful moment! ☮️
It flies away fast! Everyone's FURIOUS! Moonbeam: 'That was a GIFT and you RUINED IT!' 😡

early.text: 🏠 Endless identical houses. Perfect lawns. No people. Stardust: 'This is my NIGHTMARE.'

choices.message: Bob Dylan LOUD! You're singing about FREEDOM! The houses can't touch you! WIN! 🎵✌️

choices.text: 😨 'Floor it! Get us OUT of here!'
choices.message: You BURN rubber escaping! Everyone breathes again! River: 'Never going back to THAT life!' 🚐💨
Heavy silence for 50 miles. Everyone's thinking about the lives they left. Dark vibes. 😔

early.text: 🎪 'WORLD'S LARGEST BALL OF YARN - NEXT EXIT!' Stardust: 'That's the STUPIDEST thing ever!'

choices.message: It's MASSIVE! And totally absurd! You take goofy photos! Laughing for HOURS! Worth it! 😂
You drive past. Probably the right call. Still... you're a LITTLE curious.
Caught immediately! They make you PAY for it! River: 'Smooth criminal, you are NOT.' 🤦

early.text: 🐿️ SQUIRREL darts in front! You have 1 second to react!

choices.message: You swerve HARD! The squirrel makes it! Everyone CHEERS! River: 'ALL life is sacred!' ✨🐿️
You stop just in time! Squirrel scampers away! Close call! Everyone breathes again. Phew! 😅
THUMP. Everyone goes silent. Moonbeam won't talk to you for 50 miles. Stardust: 'Murderer.' BAD karma. 😢

early.text: 🦨 Dead skunk in the road! You see it at the LAST second!

choices.message: You miss it by INCHES! Everyone cheers! River: 'Nice reflexes!' Crisis averted! ✨
You hit it DEAD CENTER. The SMELL. Oh god the SMELL. It won't leave. You stop for HOURS trying to air out. NIGHTMARE. 🤢💀
You hit it but the smell is MINIMAL! Smart thinking! Still not GREAT but could be WAY worse!

early.text: 📻 Radio is STUCK on polka music! Accordion! Tuba! Oom-pah-pah! It WON'T CHANGE!

choices.message: You pull over and have a POLKA DANCE PARTY! It's HILARIOUS! Laughing for miles! Best bad decision ever! 🎺💃
You drown out the polka with your OWN music! Problem solved! Teamwork! 🎸

choices.text: 😤 'Turn it OFF! I can't take it!'
choices.message: Silent driving for 100 miles. Awkward. River: 'The polka would've been better than THIS.' 😐

early.text: 🕉️ Roadside compound with a HUGE sign: 'THE CHILDREN OF THE ETERNAL LIGHT - Free Love, Free Food, Free Your Mind!' A smiling guru waves.

choices.message: You spend the day. The guru is MAGNETIC. Talks about consciousness, unity, liberation. One of your crew is REALLY into it. Eyes glazed. 'Maybe we should stay longer...?' 😵‍💫
You eat the food (it's AMAZING), nod politely at the sermon, and leave. One of your crew keeps looking back. 'That guru was... intense.' 👀
You drive past. One of your crew: 'How is that different from what WE'RE doing?' Good question. Uncomfortable silence. 😬

middle.text: 🐄 Entire herd of cows blocking the road! They're NOT moving! It's been 20 minutes!

choices.message: You take AMAZING photos with the cows! One licks Moonbeam's face! Laughing so hard you CRY! Worth the delay! 🐄📷
You play guitar for the COWS! They seem to enjoy it! One actually moos along! Eventually they wander off! MAGIC! 🎵🐄
They scatter fast! But everyone's mad at you. River: 'Why do you have to HARSH everything?' 😤

middle.text: 🌾 Endless corn fields stretch to the horizon. It's beautiful but monotonous.
🏜️ The plains go on FOREVER. Kansas is really, really flat.
⛰️ The view from this mountain is outta sight! Far out!
🌄 Rocky Mountain sunrise. Everyone's speechless. Worth getting up early.
🚧 Construction zone. Detour adds an hour. Total drag.
❄️ Unexpected cold snap in the mountains. Nobody packed warm clothes.
Some swell folks share home cooking! Far out!
Camp under the stars. Outta sight.
The bus overheats climbing a mountain pass! Gotta let it cool down. Drag city.
You meet traveling musicians who jam with you! Real keen cats!
🌈 RAINBOW over the Rockies! Everyone loses their minds. It's beautiful, man.
A commune invites you to stay the night! Free food and some real hip folks.
🎸 Music store! Moonbeam: 'Can we get new guitar strings?! And look at that BONGO!' ($30 for both)

choices.message: NEW STRINGS! BONGOS! You jam in the parking lot for HOURS! A crowd gathers! Someone throws $20! LEGENDARY! 🎸🥁
The strings sound AMAZING! Worth every penny! Guitar sounds NEW! River is in heaven! 🎵
Everyone's disappointed. Stardust: 'We can afford GAS but not MUSIC? What are we DOING?!' 😔

middle.text: ⛈️ MASSIVE rainstorm! Everything's getting SOAKED! Sleeping bags! Clothes! Everything!

choices.message: You all run out and DANCE in the rain! Soaked to the BONE! Laughing like MANIACS! This is LIVING! 🌧️💃
You frantically grab stuff! Most things stay dry! Smart move! Still a bit wet but manageable! 😅
EVERYTHING is soaked. Sleeping bags RUINED. You spend a DAY trying to dry out. Stardust: 'REALLY?!' 💀

middle.text: 💵 You find $50 in an old jacket! Stardust: 'That's MY jacket!' River: 'Finders keepers!'

choices.message: Stardust: 'You're a REAL one!' She buys everyone ice cream with it! Good karma ALWAYS wins! 🍦✨
Everybody wins! You all celebrate! River: 'This is what community MEANS!' Perfect solution! ☮️
Awkward silence. Stardust glares at you for 100 miles. River: 'That's not groovy, man.' Bad vibes. 😤

middle.text: 📬 Mail call! River got a letter. 'Oh man... draft notice.' Everyone goes quiet. Then Moonbeam: 'Road trip to Canada?'

choices.message: River rips it up! 'YEAH! Screw the Man!' You all cheer! Someone plays 'Born to Be Wild' on guitar. FREEDOM! 🎸✌️
You pool $50 for app fees. River: 'Maybe I'll study philosophy! Stick it to the System THAT way!' Smart move! 📚

choices.text: 🎸 'Play some music. We'll figure it out.'
choices.message: Guitar comes out. You jam for hours. The letter sits there, but right now? You're LIVING. Music > war. ☮️

middle.text: ✊ ANTI-WAR PROTEST ahead! Thousands marching! 'Hell no, we won't go!' Signs everywhere. Do you join?

choices.text: ✊ 'This is WHY we're traveling! Join the march!'
choices.message: You march for HOURS. Chanting, singing, connecting with thousands who feel the same. This is HISTORY. This is what MATTERS. ✌️🕊️

choices.text: 📸 'Let's document this. The world needs to see.'
choices.message: You take photos, talk to protesters, soak it all in. Moonbeam: 'We're witnessing a revolution.' You'll never forget this day.

choices.text: 🚐 'Too risky. The fuzz might crack down.'
choices.message: You drive past. Everyone's silent. River mutters, 'When did we get so scared?' The guilt lingers for miles.

middle.text: 🎖️ At a diner, a young vet sits alone. Thousand-yard stare. His hands shake as he drinks coffee. He's maybe 22.

choices.message: He talks for an hour. The horrors. The lies. The friends he lost. You buy him breakfast. He thanks you. 'Just... don't let them send more kids.'
He takes it, confused at first. Then he almost smiles. 'Peace,' he whispers. Small gesture. Huge meaning.
You eat in silence. The weight of the war sits heavy on every table. There's no escaping it, even 5000 miles from Vietnam.

middle.text: 📰 Stardust sees a Help Wanted sign. 'Mechanic needed. Good pay.' She's quiet. 'I could... settle down. Get a real job.'

choices.text: 🌻 'The ROAD is your job! Don't give up the dream!'
choices.message: Stardust grins. 'You're right! Screw the Man! Let's keep rolling!' The freedom is worth the empty wallet. Far out! 🚐✌️

choices.text: 💼 'Hey, if you need to work, we understand.'
choices.message: She thinks hard. Finally: 'No. Not yet. I'm not ready for the cage.' But you can tell she's torn. The System pulls hard.
She stays quiet for 50 miles. The question lingers: how long can you run from 'real life'? Is freedom just postponing the inevitable?

middle.text: 🏡 You find a COMMUNE! 40 people living together, farming, sharing everything. 'Stay! Join us!' they offer. Tempting...

choices.text: 🌻 'This is the DREAM! Let's stay a while!'
choices.message: You stay for a week. Working the land. Sharing meals. Real community. It's BEAUTIFUL. But the road calls. You leave with full hearts & bellies. ☮️

choices.text: 🚐 'Love the idea, but we gotta keep moving.'
choices.message: They pack you food and give you flowers. 'The road is a commune too,' they say. 'Safe travels, family.' ✌️
Moonbeam: 'Too weird? WE'RE hippies!' Everyone argues for 30 miles. Maybe you're not as free-spirited as you thought.

middle.text: 🧘 Gas station. A woman in white robes approaches. 'You all have such BEAUTIFUL energy. The Master wants to meet you. We have a ranch 20 miles north.'

choices.message: You visit the 'ranch.' It's... nice? Too nice. Everyone's TOO happy. They ask for 'donations.' One of your crew is FASCINATED. Keeps talking about 'The Awakening.' 😵‍💫
She smiles serenely. 'The universe will guide you back to us when you're ready.' She gives you a pamphlet. One of your crew pockets it. 👀
You speed out of there. River: 'That was CREEPY.' But one of your crew is quiet. 'She was kinda right about the energy thing...'

late.text: 🌅 You're CLOSE now. California. The dream. But Stardust is quiet. 'What happens when we GET there? Then what?'

choices.text: 🌈 'We'll figure it out! That's the beauty of it!'
choices.message: River: 'EXACTLY! We're not about PLANS, man! We're about LIVING!' The vibe lifts. This is about the journey, not the destination. ✌️

choices.text: 💭 'Honestly? I don't know. And that's scary.'
choices.message: The truth hangs there. Nobody has answers. But at least you're all uncertain TOGETHER. That counts for something.

choices.text: 🎸 'We'll start a band! Live on the beach!'
choices.message: Everyone laughs. Making music, making memories. That's the dream. That's ALL that matters. Let's GOOOO! 🎵🌊

late.text: 🌵 Desert heat is brutal. You're all sweating buckets.
🏜️ Miles and miles of empty desert. Not a soul in sight.
🦎 A lizard sunbathes on a rock. It's too hot to even move.
🌄 Sierra Nevada peaks in the distance! Almost to California!
🌊 You can SMELL the ocean! San Francisco is close!
🌲 Redwood forest! These trees are ANCIENT. Mind-blowing.
💦 Secret desert OASIS! Crystal clear water! Moonbeam: 'This is a MIRACLE!' Nobody around for MILES!

choices.message: EPIC water day! Diving! Splashing! Best day of the TRIP! You feel REBORN! This is PARADISE! 💦✨
TOTAL FREEDOM! No clothes! No rules! Pure hippie vibes! This is what it's ALL ABOUT! 🌺☮️
Everyone's FURIOUS. River: 'We're in the DESERT and you passed WATER?!' Massive regret for 100 miles. 😤

late.text: 🎨 Artist at rest stop: 'Your bus needs ART! Can I paint it?!' He's got TONS of paint!

choices.message: He paints for HOURS! Flowers! Peace signs! RAINBOWS! Your bus is a MASTERPIECE! Everyone takes photos! LEGENDARY! 🎨✨
Perfect peace sign on the side! Simple and beautiful! River: 'Now we look like REAL hippies!' ☮️
Artist looks sad. Everyone's disappointed. Moonbeam: 'We're supposed to be about EXPRESSION!' 😔

late.text: 📻 'CALIFORNIA DREAMIN' comes on! THE perfect song! THE perfect moment! Everyone FEELS it!

choices.message: You're ALL singing at the TOP of your lungs! Tears streaming! This is IT! This is EVERYTHING! 🎵💕
You stop and DANCE! Under the desert sun! To THIS song! This moment is FOREVER! PURE MAGIC! 💃✨
Dead silence. River turns off the radio. Nobody talks for an hour. You RUINED the moment. 😤

late.text: A commune in the desert invites you to stay! Free food and cosmic vibes.
👕 Hippie at rest stop: 'I make tie-dye! Pick one! Free! Spread the love!' SO MANY COLORS!

choices.message: You offer $20! He's touched! 'You didn't have to!' Matching shirts! You look LEGENDARY! Group photo! 📷✨
Beautiful rainbow shirt! You wear it with PRIDE! River: 'Now you're a TRUE hippie!' ☮️
He looks confused. 'But... you're hippies?' Moonbeam: 'Seriously? FREE tie-dye?!' 🤦

late.text: 🌮 California TACO STAND! Smells INCREDIBLE! Guy says: 'Best tacos west of the Mississippi!'

choices.message: You get like 15 tacos! They're AMAZING! Best food of the TRIP! Everyone's in heaven! Worth EVERY penny! 🌮💕
SO GOOD! You immediately regret not getting MORE! But still amazing! Welcome to California! 🌮
The smell haunts you for MILES. Everyone's hungry AND mad. Stardust: 'We're in CALIFORNIA and skipping TACOS?!' 😤

late.text: 🦅 An eagle soars overhead. A sign! California awaits!
🎨 Street kid with spraypaint: 'Your bus needs a message! What should I write?!'

choices.message: He paints it HUGE on the side! Everyone who passes HONKS and CHEERS! The energy is INSANE! 🎨✨
Perfect message! People WAVE at you! Old lady gives you a thumbs up! Spreading the VIBE! ☮️💕
Kid shrugs and walks away. River: 'When did you become so BORING?' Missed opportunity. 😐

late.text: 🫐 WILD BERRIES everywhere! Bushes LOADED! Moonbeam: 'Are these... safe to eat?'

choices.message: You pick for HOURS! SO MANY berries! Fresh food! Nature provides! This is LIVING! 🫐✨
You pick carefully. They're DELICIOUS! Should've gotten more but at least you're safe! 🍓
You drive past. A family is picking them happily. They wave. Stardust: 'We're so PARANOID.' 😐

late.text: You find $50 in an old jacket! Far out!
🕉️ Desert rest stop. The Children of the Eternal Light are HERE. The guru recognizes you. 'You've returned! The universe guided you back! One of you is READY for transcendence...'

choices.message: You stay for THREE DAYS. Meditation. Chanting. The guru's words feel PROFOUND. When you leave, one of your crew won't stop talking about The Light. Their eyes are... different. 😵‍💫⚠️
The guru nods. 'San Francisco is an illusion. But go. You'll return when you understand.' One of your crew looks TORN. 'What if he's right...?'
You floor it. River: 'That was TOO close.' But one of your crew is FURIOUS. 'You don't understand! He SEES things!' Bad tension.

endings: You and your friends started a commune in the redwoods. Twenty years later, it's still thriving. People come from all over to learn about organic farming and free love. You never stopped believing. ☮️
The five of you became legends in Haight-Ashbury. Your bus is parked permanently on a corner, turned into a free coffee shop. Locals call you 'the originals.' The spirit lives on. 🌻
You founded a music collective that toured the country spreading peace. Your story inspired thousands to hit the road. Some say the journey never really ends. 🎸

professionEndings.dealer: By the 80s, you'd opened a chain of 'organic wellness stores.' You don't talk about the old days much. The VW bus is in your garage, covered in dust. Sometimes you wonder what happened to the dream. 💼
professionEndings.artist: Your 'authentic hippie experience' memoir became a bestseller in 1985. You do book tours in a suit. The irony isn't lost on you. The bus sold at auction for $50,000. 📚
professionEndings.dropout: You used the trip as a business school essay. MBA, corner office, stock options. The bus is long gone. Your kids think the old photos are Photoshopped. You don't tell them the truth. 🏢

epilogues.template: You made it, but the others drifted away. You stayed in touch for a while - Christmas cards, the occasional phone call. But people change. You still have the photos, though. Sometimes that's enough. {{partySizeIcon}}

itemEndings.guitar: You never left San Francisco. Busking on street corners turned into coffee shop gigs, then small venues. You're not famous, but you're free. The bus is parked by the ocean. You play music every sunset. 🎸
itemEndings.default: You documented the whole journey in sketches and paintings. A gallery in North Beach gave you your first show. Critics called it 'raw' and 'authentic.' You called it 'Tuesday.' Your art spoke what words couldn't. 🎨

moraleEndings.high: Turns out, leaving college was the best decision you ever made. You went back eventually - on your own terms - to study environmental science. Now you teach. Your students call you 'the cool professor.' You still have the bus. 🌱
moraleEndings.low: You drifted for a few more years after San Francisco. Eventually found your way - just took longer than expected. Looking back, the journey taught you more than any classroom ever could. You don't regret a thing. 🛤️

epilogues.ending: San Francisco was just the beginning. You kept going - Mexico, Canada, back across the country. The bus finally died in 1976. You bought another one. They say if you're still searching, you haven't found it yet. They're wrong. The road IS what you found. 🚐

You stayed in San Francisco for a few years, then moved back east. Got a job, settled down. But every few years, you rent an RV and hit the road again. The spirit never really left you - it just learned to coexist with reality. ✌️

The trip was harder than you expected. But you made it. Years later, you realize it wasn't about the destination - it was about proving to yourself that you could do hard things. The bus is gone, but the lesson remains. 🌅

You made it to San Francisco. The music festival was everything you hoped for and nothing like you expected. Life went on. But sometimes, when you hear a certain song, you're back in that VW bus, wind in your hair, whole life ahead of you. Those were the days. 🌻
